concepts.name: 反転天陸

concepts.name: 斜光断層
concepts.core: urban strata shear vertically and expose kilometers of inhabited city interiors
concepts.requires: urban floorplates compose silhouette; not twin giant blank cliffs

concepts.name: 多層天核
concepts.core: interlocked inhabited topological city layers transform inside/outside relations
concepts.requires: linked real rooms, voids and streets; not one detached stadium or ornamental ring
